name: Will new bathroom flooring make the door or toilet sit too high?

mainEntity.name: Will new bathroom flooring make the door or toilet sit too high?

acceptedAnswer.text: Floor height matters because a thicker tile assembly or underlayment can interfere with doors, toilet flange height, vanity clearances, transitions, and adjacent rooms. A thinner material may reduce those issues but can involve different preparation and durability tradeoffs. Ask for the proposed finished-floor height and how it will meet the hallway or bedroom flooring. Elite Remodeling & Design can include transitions and surrounding design decisions when coordinating a bathroom renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can. New tile, underlayment, leveling compounds, or layered flooring may raise the finished floor and affect door clearance, toilet flange height, vanity fit, and transitions. Ask for the planned finished-floor height before installation and confirm who will adjust doors, transitions, or fixture details if needed.
